Ourark World Studio · optional integration

Kart, aircraft and walking source

The controllers, renderer and local multiplayer server are included. The original aerial imagery, terrain and geodata bundles are excluded from this public release. This entry page makes no external requests.

For a working example with no extra assets, open Map Studio. To use the kart integration, prepare a separately licensed motionspec.kart.track.v1 bundle under dist/kart/assets/ and follow docs/INTEGRATIONS.md in the repository. Networking and telemetry have separate controls.

Open the integration after installing its data. The default map name is rosenberg; use the map query parameter for another supported bundle. The net=0 option disables multiplayer only. Telemetry is enabled by default in the original integration and has a separate switch in the Insights panel.
